DATE Thursday, Aug. 6, 2026 at 5 p.m. ET CALL PARTICIPANTS Head of Investor Relations - Ben Lu CEO - Vincent Pilette CFO - Natalie Derse TAKEAWAYS Non-GAAP Revenue -- $1.336 billion, growing 11% adjusted for an extra fiscal week in the prior year and including MoneyLion stub period results. Non-GAAP EPS -- $0.71, an increase of 19% year over year that exceeded the company guidance range of $0.68 to $0.70. Total Bookings -- $1.284 billion, representing 11% adjusted growth and marking the fifth consecutive quarter of double-digit bookings expansion. Total Paid Customers -- 81 million, an increase from 76 million in the prior year and representing the 11th consecutive quarter of sequential growth. Cyber Safety Revenue -- $846 million, reflecting 4% adjusted growth driven by strong performance in higher-tier Norton 360 all-in-one memberships. Trust-Based Solutions Revenue -- $490 million, increasing 24% adjusted as the company scaled its identity and personal financial management offerings. Non-GAAP Operating Income -- $668 million, up 9% compared to the adjusted prior year period while sustaining a stable 50.0% operating margin. Cyber Safety Operating Margin -- 61%, remaining durable as the company balanced mid-single-digit top-line growth with disciplined execution. Trust-Based Solutions Operating Margin -- 30%, held stable despite significant growth investments in the MoneyLion and Engine Marketplace verticals. LifeLock Retention -- Reaching nearly 90%, reflecting strong customer engagement with financial asset monitoring and restoration services. Norton Cross-sell Penetration -- 27%, representing a one percentage point increase year over year as product targeting algorithms improved. Engine Marketplace Annual Revenue Run Rate -- $500 million, bolstered by the addition of 30 new partners and expansion into the insurance vertical. Connected Financial Accounts -- 110 million, up from 75 million at the time of the MoneyLion acquisition, deepening the platform data set. Non-GAAP Gross Margin -- 82.0%, a slight decline from the prior year due to a shift in product mix toward the Engine Marketplace business model. Free Cash Flow -- $430 million, supporting a robust liquidity position of over $2 billion including the company revolver. Net Leverage -- 2.95x, falling below the company target of 3.0x following the repayment of $45 million in debt during the quarter. Fiscal Year 2027 Revenue Guidance -- Raised to a range of $5.375 billion to $5.475 billion, representing expected growth of 9% to 11%. Fiscal Year 2027 Non-GAAP EPS Guidance -- Raised to a range of $2.87 to $2.97, reflecting projected growth of 14% to 18%. Q2 Fiscal Year 2027 Revenue Guidance -- Estimated between $1.325 billion and $1.35 billion, a projected increase of 9% to 11%. Capital Returns -- $181 million returned to shareholders, including $100 million in share repurchases and $81 million in quarterly dividends. Scam Protection Engine -- Blocked more than 500 million attacks during the quarter, including deepfakes and voice clones, protecting users at a rate of 100 per second. AI Creative Efficiency -- 25% improvement in efficiency for marketing creative piloting, allowing the production of twice the assets with the same resource levels. Financial Wellness Adoption -- 35% of the paid customer base now engages with financial wellness tools, up from previous periods as cross-sell into the Norton base increased. Email [email protected] RISKS Derse noted that some of the fastest-growing marketplace categories have a unique business model where it has slightly lower gross margin due to revenue share but also carries a lower OpEx burden, creating a mix dynamic for total company margins. SUMMARY Management reported first-quarter results that exceeded previous guidance, leading to an upward revision of the full-year outlook for revenue and earnings. The company stated that its platform integration strategy is successfully combining cybersecurity with financial wellness to deepen customer relationships and increase cross-sell penetration. The transition toward a comprehensive membership model remains a central focus as the company incorporates AI capabilities across its product suite. Executives indicated that the Engine Marketplace expansion and embedded financial services are providing a structurally higher growth trajectory for the business. CEO Pilette noted that concerns about AI-driven scams are a primary purchase driver for the company, with over 60% of consumers citing this as a reason to pay for protection. The company reported that Norton Neo, an AI-native browser, doubled its daily active users through the deployment of its contextual agentic VPN. Management deployed its Sage agent security engine to 25 million customers across the Norton 360 and Avast One platforms to provide multi-layer protection. The company launched a beta of the Norton Family Assistant, co-architected with xAI, to handle family and financial actions within a controlled trust envelope. CFO Derse stated, "Our philosophy of driving earnings growth faster than revenue growth continues to be our North Star," while highlighting the 19% non-GAAP EPS growth. CEO Pilette indicated that the company moat widens with every new model partner, agent, and connected account deployed in the environment. INDUSTRY GLOSSARY Cyber Safety : The segment focusing on security, privacy, and comprehensive protection suites under brands like Norton and Avast. Trust-Based Solutions : The segment encompassing identity theft protection, reputation management, and financial wellness services. Engine Marketplace : An AI-driven embedded marketplace connecting consumers to financial products such as loans, credit cards, and insurance. ARPU : Average Revenue Per User, a metric measuring the average income generated per customer. PFM : Personal Financial Management, services including credit building and cash flow management tools. Agentic AI : AI systems capable of taking actions on behalf of a user, such as making purchases or scheduling events. ATH : Agent Trust Hub, the company framework for controlling and securing AI agent interactions. Instacash : A MoneyLion product providing users with small, short-term cash advances. Sage : An open-source agent security engine developed by the company to provide multi-layer protection for AI agents.
